requirements.text: Purely combinational 32-bit ULA with two operands, 4-bit control, 32-bit result, and zero flag.
Implement AND, OR, ADD, SUB, signed SLT, and NOR using the specified MIPS-style controls.
Assert zero exactly when result is zero.
Undefined controls produce zero result and asserted zero flag.
Addition and subtraction use 32-bit modular arithmetic.
SLT interprets operands as signed two's-complement values.
Synthesizable portable VHDL using IEEE numeric_std.
Traceable cocotb testbench run through GHDL with one command.
